description: Two regional English catalogs plus an unrelated fallback. Requests are written so that TWO specific heuristic ranges compete for them: neither range is an anchor for either catalog (no exact, canonical, structural or CLDR-fallback relationship exists between en-US/en-CA/en-Latn-US and en-GB/en-AU), so both go through assignPreferredSpecificHeuristicLocales and its comparator decides which range claims which catalog. The configured tiebreaker order makes the first claim deterministic, so the OUTPUT reveals the comparator's ordering.
